verdict.rationale: Netlify's core workflow is Git-based auto-deploy with PR previews and works alongside existing CI/editor setups without requiring proprietary CI or IDE (netlify-docs-1, netlify-comm-7, netlify-comm-10). It also offers a CLI and REST API for automation that layer on top of, rather than replace, standard dev tooling (netlify-docs-14, netlify-docs-15).
